timeout 600 /opt/sglang/bin/python3 -B -c '"""Retain pinned KV-store launch source without loading CUDA."""

from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path


package = Path(importlib.util.find_spec("sglang").origin).parent
job = os.environ["KUBEBRAIN_RJOB_NAME"]
archive = Path(sys.argv[1]) / job
archive.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
files = []
source_suffixes = {".py", ".pyi", ".pyx", ".pxd", ".pxi", ".c", ".cu", ".cuh", ".cpp", ".cc", ".h", ".hpp", ".hh", ".hxx", ".inl", ".inc"}
sglang_suffix_counts = Counter()
for source in sorted(package.rglob("*")):
    if not source.is_file():
        continue
    sglang_suffix_counts[source.suffix] += 1
    if source.suffix not in source_suffixes:
        continue
    relative = source.relative_to(package).as_posix()
    content = source.read_bytes()
    target = archive / "source" / relative
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with target.open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(content)
    files.append({"path": relative, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(), "bytes": len(content)})

stores = [entry for entry in files if entry["path"].startswith("kernels/ops/kvcache/")]
if not stores:
    raise RuntimeError("The pinned package does not contain the imported KV-store package")
tvm_package = Path(importlib.util.find_spec("tvm_ffi").origin).parent
tvm_files = []
tvm_suffix_counts = Counter()
for source in sorted(tvm_package.rglob("*")):
    if not source.is_file():
        continue
    tvm_suffix_counts[source.suffix] += 1
    if source.suffix not in source_suffixes:
        continue
    relative = "tvm_ffi/" + source.relative_to(tvm_package).as_posix()
    content = source.read_bytes()
    target = archive / "source" / relative
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with target.open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(content)
    entry = {"path": relative, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(), "bytes": len(content)}
    files.append(entry)
    tvm_files.append(entry)
if not tvm_files:
    raise RuntimeError("The installed TVM FFI package exposes no source or headers")
receipt = {"job": job, "image": sys.argv[2], "package": str(package),
           "sglang_version": importlib.metadata.version("sglang"), "requested_gpus": 0,
           "selection": "Complete installed SGLang and TVM FFI Python/Cython/C/CUDA source and headers",
           "files": files, "store_files": stores, "tvm_ffi_package": str(tvm_package),
           "tvm_ffi_distributions": {name: importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in importlib.metadata.packages_distributions().get("tvm_ffi", [])},
           "tvm_ffi_files": tvm_files,
           "source_suffixes": sorted(source_suffixes),
           "sglang_suffix_counts": dict(sorted(sglang_suffix_counts.items())),
           "tvm_ffi_suffix_counts": dict(sorted(tvm_suffix_counts.items())),
           "cython_files": [entry for entry in files if Path(entry["path"]).suffix in {".pyx", ".pxd", ".pxi"}]}
with (archive / "source.json").open("x") as stream:
    json.dump(receipt, stream, indent=2)
    stream.write("\n")
print(json.dumps({"job": job, "files": len(files), "store_files": len(stores), "requested_gpus": 0}), flush=True)
